the aerodynamic characteristics of a fixed wing with a slotted cylinder rotating at the trailing edge are studied by CFD approach.The results show that the cylinder can generate a sine exciting force when it rotates at a constant speed.The amplitude of the exciting force is related with the distance between cylinder and the trailing edge of airfoil.The amplitude of the lift is related with the rotating phase angles of cylinder and the airflow velocities.The abrupt changes of the lift are observed at phase angles of 45°±3° and
the aerodynamic excitation characteristics of the trailing edge rotating slotted cylinder can be used as a new type of flutter generator.
The lift of the airfoil varies periodically with the variation of phase angles of the rotating cylinder.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the aerodynamics of a new type of rotating exciter, which is a two dimensional lifting wing with a slotted trailing edge rotating cylinder.
the aerodynamic characteristics of the new type of exciter and its application to the study of flutter excitation.
the static and dynamic characteristics of a two dimensional wing with trailing edge rotating slotted cylinder.

the slotted rotating cylinder can provide a simple, effective and efficient method of exciting the flutter of a lifting surface.
the rotating cylinder at trailing edge of a lifting surface is a very promising flutter exciter.

this exciter can generate a sine-wave exciting force at a constant rotating rate, and the amplitude and frequency of the exciting force can be controlled by the rotating rate and distance between the trailing-edge of the airfoil to the leading-edge of the cylinder.
